records.locator: Abstract, Methods, Results and Table I, printed pp. 128–130

model_extraction.access_note: The primary author abstract corroborates three DCS-related terminations and eight grade III–IV VGE observations. The publisher's indexed article excerpts provide the individual rows and the stopping criteria. The complete journal PDF and page images were unavailable in this pass.
model_extraction.overlap_note: Diesel studied selected volunteers at AFRL, Brooks AFB. Balldin and colleagues report a broader archive from the same laboratory. Exposure dates and archive crosswalk are unavailable for the eight rows. Independence remains unresolved.

observations.locator: Abstract, Methods and Results, printed pp. 129–130
observations.note: Aggregate endpoint as stated by the authors. Individual termination flags were not transcribed.
observations.protocol: Selected male nonsmokers with subclinical tricuspid regurgitation at AFRL, Brooks AFB. The planned exposure was 24,000 ft for 4 h. Investigators adjusted altitude and activity in response to VGE. Individual pressure and gas histories are unavailable.
observations.outcome_window: During the reported chamber exposure. Uniform delayed clinical surveillance is unavailable.
